description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Exception, which is a specific exception class for the Zend XML-RPC Value component. It extends the base Zend_XmlRpc_Exception and is used to handle exceptions related to values within the XML-RPC framework.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Exception
classes.description: A specialized exception class for errors within the Zend XmlRpc Value component, extending Zend_XmlRpc_Exception.
